brand.intro: How each company appears to its customers and suppliers: the logo on its portal, its link pages and its documents, its colour, and the name its mail goes out under.
brand.title: Branding
brand.description: Logo, colours and e-mail sender name per company
brand.readOnly: You can see this company's branding. Changing it needs the right to change a company's branding (an administrator has it).

empty.title: No branding yet
empty.body: Customers and suppliers see {company} written in text, with the standard colours.

logo.label: Logo
logo.hint: On the portal, the link pages and above the company's name on its documents. PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB; a wide logo on a clear background works best.

logoDark.label: Logo for dark pages
logoDark.hint: A light version for pages in dark mode. Empty: the logo above is used on dark pages too.

logo.none: No logo: the company's name in text
logo.noneDark: None: the logo above is used
logo.hint: PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB

problem.type: This file is not a PNG or JPEG picture. Save the logo as PNG or JPEG and pick it again.
problem.size: This picture is larger than 1 MB. Make it smaller and pick it again.
problem.notPicture: The file says it is a picture, but its contents are not a PNG or JPEG. Export the logo again and pick it.
problem.upload: The picture could not be uploaded. Check the connection and pick it again.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.hint: The company's colour as #rrggbb. It is used only where it can be read well: the standard colours stay where it cannot.
accent.invalid: Type a colour as #rrggbb, for example #1f5fa8.

sender.label: Sender name for mail
sender.hint: The name mail to customers and suppliers goes out under. Empty: {company}.
sender.unsafe: No angle brackets, quotes or backslashes: the name goes into the From line of the mail.

label.label: Portal name
label.hint: What the portal calls itself, shown before a partner signs in. Empty: {company}.

field.oneLine: Keep it on one line, without special control characters.

use.PRIMARY: Buttons, links and marks in this colour ({ratio} against the page).
use.ACCENT: Only lines and marks in this colour; buttons and links keep the standard colour (it reaches {ratio}, they need 7:1).
use.NONE: Not used: it reaches only {ratio} against the page. The standard colours stay.
use.NOT_GIVEN: No colour given: the standard colours.

held.noRight: Changing the branding needs the right to change a company's branding.
held.uploading: Wait until the picture is uploaded.
held.problems: Fix the fields marked in red first.
held.lightFirst: Add the logo for light pages first.

preview.label: What customers and suppliers will see
preview.heldLegal: The company's legal data is not complete yet: a document cannot be printed.
preview.documentsLogo: Quotes, purchase orders, DDTs, packing lists, invoice copies and the other documents Nexus prints carry the logo above the company's name.
preview.documentsSaved: Previews of a document show the saved branding.

done.saved: Branding saved. The portal, the link pages, mail and new documents use it from now on.
